prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Moving sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and exceeded predictions (+16.8% vs +12.0%), while moving sign-in before launch and adding sign-in hints or progress trackers showed no clear effect.
Live waiting screen enhancements (progress visualizer, audio-visual ambiance) were helpful, with visualizers far exceeding predictions (+9.3% vs +2.0%), whereas static time estimates, checklists, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Adoption tips (photo quality sound tip) were helpful and exceeded predictions (+8.7% vs +2.0%), while adoption card redesigns significantly hurt performance (-27.5%) and layout changes showed no clear effect.
Finish screen additions (control guides, notification prompts, badges, and incentives) showed no clear effect, and positive predictions were set too high.
Path selection copy, layout, and direct selection card changes showed no clear effect, with predictions over-estimating impact.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +8.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, layout: +2.4% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -15.0% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -0.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.0% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, new_screen: +3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, incentive: -4.4% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: -6.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, notification: -5.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +2.8% over 5 test(s)

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Ownership Confirmation Hint: Add a clear warning hint on sign-in clarifying that logging into an existing account restores previously adopted pets rather than overwriting or resetting them. (why: Support mail highlights 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Tray Interaction Walkthrough Redesign: Redesign the finish screen into a split view illustrating quick tray shortcuts, pet summoning, and desktop hide/show controls. (why: Finish screen drop-off is high (64.8% completion) and support mail contains 3 complaints about confusion over controlling or hiding pets after setup.)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Lighting & Angle Verification Tip: Add an interactive tip carousel on photo upload advising users on photo lighting, resolution, and single-subject framing to prevent generation errors. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off (63.8%) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.)
3: [home, wait_info] Ambient Relaxing Audio Ambient Selector: Add a sound component on the waiting screen offering background ambient audio themes during pet generation. (why: Lessons show audio-visual waiting screen enhancements significantly boost completion, while generation waiting times average 2336s.)
4: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Verification Badge Component: Add an adoption certificate badge component highlighting official pet adoption rights and digital ownership. (why: Adoption completion is relatively low (63.8%), and reinforcing adoption ownership encourages completion.)
5: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Storage Backup Assurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to emphasize automatic cloud backup of pet stats and custom settings. (why: Support emails show 8 users suffered account/pet loss confusion, so explaining cloud saves builds trust.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Split View Welcome Path Selection Layout: Change choose_path screen layout to split view, showcasing visual preview cards beside companion path choices. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s; a split layout clarifies path choices instantly without text overload.)
